verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Agent Studio, which connects a chosen LLM to Algolia search and grounds its responses in live data from your indices. It supports conversational search, shopping assistants and content summarizers, with completions cached by default. Retrieval is backed by the documented Search API, hybrid NeuralSearch and a Crawler skill that builds RAG-optimized indexes. Missing for 10: no API reference or endpoint details for Agent Studio's answer/completion API in the evidence, no detail on retrieval-for-RAG parameters such as chunking or citations, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the RAG/conversational features.
